what: Elixir 1.20.3 rejects float range bounds at construction: `1.0..10.0` raises ArgumentError "ranges (first..last//step) expect both sides to be integers, got: 1.0..10.0". A float-typed parameter therefore declares an integer Range (e.g. `1..10` or `-5..5`) plus a float `step`, and the value is coerced to float where it is decoded. The workbench design and Plan 2 were amended to this form.
why: The workbench design originally used `range: 1.0..10.0`, which cannot compile; the same trap applies to any future spec that puts float bounds in a Range.
context_label: Elixir float ranges and workbench parameters
